meta.name: report-generator
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "create a campaign report", "build an executive summary", or "deliver client results"; produces audience-tailored influencer marketing reports (executive, client, internal team) with data tables, narrative, key learnings, and recommendations. Not for raw metric computation — use performance-analyzer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成面向受众的网红营销报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为不同受众生成网红营销报告
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce influencer marketing reports for different audiences

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的营销活动数据和目标受众（高管、客户、团队等），生成一份结构完整的报告，包含数据表格、叙述、关键发现和建议。
howto.when: 当你说“创建活动报告”、“生成高管摘要”或“交付客户结果”时触发。通常在活动或报告期结束后使用。

say.text: 为我的Q3网红营销活动生成一份高管摘要。
创建一份面向客户的假日活动报告，花费5万美元，收入16.5万美元。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份客户报告，包含数据表格和结果解读。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates a structured influencer marketing report tailored to a specific audience (executive, client, team, etc.), including data tables, narrative, key learnings, and recommendations based on campaign metrics you provide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create a campaign report", "build an executive summary", or "deliver client results". Typically used after a campaign or reporting period ends.

say_en.text: Generate an executive summary for my Q3 influencer campaigns.
Create a client report for the holiday campaign with $50K spend and $165K revenue.
